entities.summary: Perth Stadium, also known as Optus Stadium under a naming rights agreement, is a multi-purpose stadium in the Burswood suburb of Perth, Western Australia. It was completed during late 2017 and officially opened on 21 January 2018. The stadium's total capacity is 61,266, including standing room, extendable to 65,000 seats for rectangular sports. It is the third-largest stadium in Australia.
